title: Base of the Closing Charge Where a Refined Fuels Account Carries Booking Money
content:
The figure a closing charge on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is worked out on is not always the amount standing on the account. Whether money has been applied against a booking, and whether money still stands committed on the bookings the account carries, decide the base.

**Where money has been applied against a booking on the account and money stands committed on the bookings the account carries**, the base the closing charge is worked out on is the fuel billed and the fees billed less the payments posted, the booking's own money being left out of it.

**Where money has been applied against a booking and no money stands committed on the bookings the account carries**, the base the closing charge is worked out on is the amount standing on the account with the money applied against the booking added back.

**Where no money has been applied against a booking on the account**, the base the closing charge is worked out on is the amount standing on the account.

| Money applied against a booking | Money committed on the bookings the account carries | The base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes, at least one such entry | Standing above nothing | The fuel billed and the fees billed, less the payments posted |
| Yes, at least one such entry | Nothing standing | The amount standing on the account, with the money applied against the booking added back |
| None | Either way | The amount standing on the account |

*Hypothetical.* An account carrying 3200.00 USD of fuel billed, 100.00 USD of fees billed, 1000.00 USD of payments posted, 1800.00 USD committed on its bookings and 2100.00 USD applied against those bookings has an amount standing of 2000.00 USD. Because money has been applied against a booking and money still stands committed, the base is 3200.00 plus 100.00 less 1000.00, coming to 2300.00 USD. Had nothing stood committed on the bookings, the base would be 2000.00 with 2100.00 added back, coming to 4100.00 USD. Had no money been applied against a booking at all, the base would be the amount standing, 2000.00 USD.
